economic_hypothesis: Price and volume can reveal that ordinary market supply was absorbed, but they cannot neutralize a fresh issuer-integrity or solvency shock. A rebound shortly after an official severe-risk disclosure is therefore a different economic population and is vetoed rather than scored more highly.

only_new_condition.rule: Admit only when zero high-precision OPEN issuer-risk title events became available in the 120 calendar days ending at the completed signal decision.
only_new_condition.window: signal_time - 120 calendar days <= event available_at <= signal_time
only_new_condition.close_treatment: An explicit CLOSE does not erase the 120-day cooling period; the gate measures recent severe disclosure, not only current legal state.
only_new_condition.threshold_origin: 120 days is an ex-ante economic cooling horizon aligned with the fixed chart context, not a searched return optimum.
only_new_condition.missing_policy: Reject unless official exchange metadata coverage, every required page, identity, hash, classification version, and available_at relation are proven for the whole window.

classifier.source_claim: Official announcement-title disclosure only; no claim about unparsed PDF contents.
classifier.date_only_policy: A source date without a clock becomes available at 00:00 on the following calendar day.
classifier.revision_limit: Current official API enumeration is PIT-B reconstructed metadata and does not claim complete supplier revision-vintage history.

outcomes_may_open_only_after: source snapshot is fully conserved, sealed, registered and revalidated
the V29 selected identity is frozen before its outcomes are joined

locked_later_periods.2022_2024: Do not collect, classify or evaluate until the development selector passes without changing this rule.
locked_later_periods.2025_plus: Post-selection observation only; 2026 known failures motivated the issuer-risk hypothesis and therefore cannot be described as pristine validation.

unchanged.entry: first legal buyable one-minute open after the completed signal
